output.reason: The release note [ev-1c6740ca1da5] only names an internal refactor. The linked PR [ev-45bd73a6076a][ev-21b8d1d0ab04] bundles several changes: a new runtime reconciler, a RuntimeHealthy condition separate from RevisionHealthy, dropping the runtime's dependency on package meta, and changing the value of the pkg.crossplane.io/provider deployment selector label from the provider name in meta to the provider package name. It does not say whether an older condition type was removed or renamed. It also does not say what happens to existing provider Deployments or to anything that selects on the old label value. It only says the selector migration is "taken care of". So the subject is split across several changes, and the consequence and exposure are not stated; the changed-file list [ev-28a7033ed41c] does not settle them either.
